items.scene: 你在地铁站售票窗口问

answers.en: How much is a one-day pass?
Do you have a day pass?
Is the day pass worth it?
answers.note: 问划不划算，适合一天要坐好几趟。

items.scene: 你在地铁站问工作人员

answers.en: Where can I top up my card?
answers.note: top up 是充值，最常用。

answers.en: Can I add money at the machine?
answers.note: add money 更直白，问机器能不能充。

answers.en: Is there a place to recharge my transit card?
answers.note: recharge 更正式，transit card 是交通卡。
answers.zh: 有给交通卡充值的地方吗？

items.scene: 你拿着交通卡问工作人员

answers.en: Is this card valid on buses?
answers.note: valid on 是可用于，问卡能不能刷公交。

answers.en: Does this card work on buses too?
answers.note: too 强调公交也能不能用。

answers.en: Is this card good for both subway and bus?
answers.note: 问是不是地铁公交通用。
answers.zh: 这张卡地铁公交都能用吗？

items.scene: 你在地铁站问工作人员

answers.en: How is the fare calculated?
answers.note: fare 是票价，calculated 是按什么算。

answers.en: How much is a subway ride?
Does the price depend on distance?

items.scene: 你上出租车后问司机

answers.en: What does it run to downtown?
answers.note: run 在这里是“要多少钱”，很口语。

answers.en: What's the fare to the city center?
answers.zh: 到市中心的票价是多少？

answers.en: How much to get downtown?

items.zh: 打车到高铁站大概多久？
items.scene: 你上车后问司机

answers.en: How many minutes to the high-speed rail station?
answers.note: 问具体分钟数，比 how long 更直接。

answers.en: About how long to the train station by taxi?
answers.note: by taxi 说清楚是打车。
answers.zh: 打车到火车站大概多久？

answers.en: Is it far to the station?
answers.note: 问远不远，不一定要准确时间。

items.scene: 你让司机在路边停一下

answers.en: Could you wait five minutes?
Can you hold on for a bit?
answers.note: hold on 是等一会儿，更口语。

answers.en: Would you mind waiting?
answers.note: 更客气，适合不确定要等多久。

items.scene: 你拉开副驾车门问司机

answers.en: Can I sit in the front?
Is it okay if I sit up front?
answers.note: up front 是前排，更口语。

answers.en: Do you mind if I ride shotgun?
answers.note: ride shotgun 是坐副驾，很地道。

items.scene: 你上车后觉得热

answers.en: Could you turn on the AC?
Can you crank up the AC?
answers.note: crank up 是调大，适合很热时。

answers.en: Is it okay to turn on the air?
answers.note: the air 是口语里的空调。

items.scene: 你上车后问司机

answers.en: Could you put on some music?
answers.note: put on music 是放音乐。

answers.en: Do you mind some music?
answers.note: 更客气，问对方介不介意。

answers.en: Can we have the radio on?
answers.note: radio 是收音机，问能不能开着。

items.scene: 你拿着行李站在车后

answers.en: Could you open the trunk?
Can you pop the trunk?
answers.note: pop the trunk 是弹开后备箱，很地道。

answers.en: Is the trunk open?
answers.note: 已经按了但没开，问是不是开了。

items.scene: 你问司机

answers.en: Can I put my bag in the trunk?
Is it okay to put my luggage in the back?
Do you have room in the trunk?
answers.note: 问后备箱还有没有地方。

items.scene: 你带着孩子打车，问司机

answers.en: Do kids need a car seat?
answers.note: car seat 是儿童安全座椅。

answers.en: Do you have a car seat?
Is a booster seat required?
answers.note: booster seat 是大童增高垫。

items.scene: 你抱着狗问司机

answers.en: Can I bring my dog?
Are pets allowed in the car?
Does the driver take pets?
answers.note: 问司机接不接带宠物的单。

items.scene: 你到目的地准备付款

answers.en: Do you take card payments?
Do you take cards?
Do I have to pay in cash?

items.scene: 你下错单，问客服

answers.en: How do I cancel the ride?
answers.note: cancel the ride 是取消行程。

answers.en: Can I cancel this ride?
Is there a cancellation fee?

items.zh: 司机取消订单了怎么办？
items.scene: 你看到订单被取消，联系客服

answers.en: The driver canceled. What now?
answers.note: What now 是接下来怎么办，口语。
answers.zh: 司机取消了，现在怎么办？

answers.en: Can you get me another driver?
answers.note: get me another driver 是再派一个司机。

answers.en: Will I be charged for that?

items.scene: 你在定位点打电话给司机

answers.en: I can't find your car.
Where exactly are you parked?
Are you by the main door?
answers.note: by the main door 是在正门旁边。

items.scene: 你在路边找车，打电话问司机

answers.en: What's your license plate number?
Which car is yours?
What color is your car?

items.scene: 你在地铁上跟朋友说

answers.en: There's no signal in the subway.
I can't get any service down here.
answers.note: service 是手机服务，down here 指地下。
answers.zh: 这下面一点信号都没有。

answers.en: Does the subway have WiFi?

items.scene: 你在地铁站问工作人员

answers.en: How do I get home after the last train?
answers.note: after the last train 是末班车之后。

answers.en: Are there night buses?
Can I still get a taxi that late?
answers.note: 问那么晚还能不能打到车。

items.scene: 你上公交前问司机

answers.en: Do I pay cash or tap a card?
Do you take coins?
Can I tap my phone?

items.scene: 你在地铁上问旁边乘客

answers.en: I'm going the wrong way.
answers.note: the wrong way 是反方向。

answers.en: How do I get back?
Which platform goes the other way?

items.scene: 你上公交后问旁边乘客

answers.en: Does the bus announce the stops?
Will they call out the stops?
answers.note: call out 是喊出来，更口语。

answers.en: How do I know when to get off?
answers.zh: 我怎么知道什么时候下车？

items.scene: 你在地铁站问工作人员

answers.en: Is there a restroom in the station?
Where's the bathroom?
Do I need a ticket to use it?
answers.note: 问用厕所要不要刷票进站。

items.scene: 你拖着大箱子在地铁站问

answers.en: Can I take a big suitcase on the subway?
Is luggage allowed on the subway?
Is there a size limit?

items.scene: 你在安检口问工作人员

answers.en: What can't I bring on the subway?
Are drinks allowed?
Can I bring my bike?

items.scene: 你骑着共享单车问路人

answers.en: How do I return this bike?
Where do I park it when I'm done?
Do I need to lock it?

items.scene: 你扫码前发现车有问题

answers.en: This bike is broken.
The chain came off.
answers.note: chain 是链条，came off 是掉了。

answers.en: Can I report this bike?

items.scene: 你骑到运营区外，App 提示不能还车

answers.en: I rode outside the service area.
What happens if I park outside the zone?
Can I still return it here?

items.scene: 你在停车场出口问工作人员

answers.en: How do I pay for parking?
Where do I pay?
Can I pay at the exit?

items.scene: 你回到车上发现超时，问管理员

answers.en: I stayed past my time. What do I do?
answers.note: stayed past my time 是超时。

answers.en: Will I get a ticket?
Can I pay the difference?

items.scene: 你在收费站问工作人员

answers.en: How much is the toll?
How much are the tolls to Shanghai?
answers.zh: 到上海过路费一共多少？

answers.en: Do I pay cash at the toll booth?
answers.note: toll booth 是收费站，问能不能付现。

items.scene: 你在加油站问工作人员

answers.en: How do I pay for gas?
Can I pay at the pump?
answers.note: pay at the pump 是在加油机旁刷卡。

answers.en: Do I pay inside?

items.scene: 你停在路边打电话求助

answers.en: My car ran out of gas.
answers.note: ran out of gas 是没油了。

answers.en: Can you bring me some gas?
Where's the closest gas station?
answers.note: 问最近的加油站在哪儿。

items.scene: 你发现车胎瘪了，打电话求助

answers.en: My tire is flat.
I have a flat tire.
Can you help me change it?

items.scene: 你回来发现车不见了，问交警

answers.en: My car got towed.
Where did they take it?
Where do I pick up my car?
